messages.connectFirst: Please connect to the game process first

misc.title: Miscellaneous tools
misc.runtimeNotice: These features modify runtime game memory and do not write to saves. Reconnect and configure them after restarting or changing game versions.
misc.runtimeHint: Requires the game to be running · Reconfigure after restart

updates.title: Check for updates
updates.alreadyLatest: You are using the latest version

position.title: Player position
position.invalid: Enter valid X, Y, and Z coordinates (absolute value up to 10000000)

flight.title: Flight mode
flight.hint: W/A/S/D move on world axes · Space ascends · Ctrl descends
flight.enabled: Flight mode enabled (keys work only while the game window is focused)

damage.title: Party damage meter
damage.hint: Requires monster HP multiplier; this automatically enables the current multiplier
damage.scaled: Raw damage is scaled by the monster enhancement multiplier
damage.enabled: Damage recording enabled; monster HP multiplier was enabled automatically

countdown.title: Quest result countdown / instant chest
countdown.notice: A result countdown above 30 seconds hides the bar but timing still works; set it to 0 seconds for instant chests.
countdown.hint: Dynamically writes two float values after AOB location

material.title: No material consumption for upgrades/enhancement/transmutation (item gains work normally; disable after use)
material.notice: Only negative material changes are blocked. Positive gains, including quest rewards and potions, retain normal behavior.
material.hint: Skip add [r14+04], esi only when esi is negative

loadoutPrivacy.title: Loadout privacy (hide build from relink-logs style tools)
loadoutPrivacy.notice: Clears the build section (sigils/summons/weapon/overmastery/skillboard) of the profile blob sent to other players in online lobbies. Names, character and levels stay visible. Enabling mid-quest only affects later syncs; re-enable after game restart.
loadoutPrivacy.hint: Zeroes blob 0x06..0x2A4 after the loadout→profile serializer runs

crab.title: Crab tools
crab.notice: Pick up one crab of the corresponding type after enabling it. Do not enable it early, and disable it after use.
crab.hint: Pick up one crab of the corresponding type after enabling it. Black-crab Steam achievements may not trigger; use Watt Toolkit instead.
crab.enabled: Inventory quantity set to {quantity}; automatically restores in 10 seconds

terminus.title: 100% Terminus weapon drop
terminus.notice: Only prevents the Terminus lot in Proto Bahamut quests from being excluded by 80%; original ownership and character-unlock checks remain.
terminus.hint: NOP Terminus lot exclusion jump after AOB location

trophy.title: Unlock all in-game titles
trophy.confirmBody: The save timing is not yet clear. You can claim quest rewards and equip selected titles; multiple “Unset” entries on the title selection screen are normal.

purpleRune.title: Show purple runes on other skins
purpleRune.hint: Switch JNE/JE at a fixed RVA
purpleRune.enabled: Purple rune display on other skins enabled

monsterEnhance.title: Monster enhancement
monsterEnhance.notice: Enabling extracts and injects the bundled patch_core.dll into a temporary directory; disabling restores original bytes on the Go side.
monsterEnhance.hint: DLL injection on · Go restore off
monsterEnhance.hintDamageNew: Enter 10 = 10× damage received by party members
monsterEnhance.hintOdRate: Enter 10 = OD gauge grows 10× faster (a 100 gain becomes 1000); 0.1 = 1/10 speed (100 → 10)
monsterEnhance.overdriveInvalid: For Overdrive, select empty gauge, full yellow gauge, or automatic OD
monsterEnhance.empty: Start the game, then refresh status

overdrive.hint: Empty/full writes once immediately; automatic OD refills after OD ends

monsterEnhance.noteWarn: This page works only for the host; notify your teammates when enabling it
monsterEnhance.note: I made this because the original game became repetitive, I wanted to try libmem, and using my own CE scripts took too many clicks. My reverse-engineering skills are average and I am not an experienced C++ developer; using pure Go for memory hooks was my biggest mistake because there were few useful libraries. A repository star would be appreciated.

overLimit.title: Over limit
overLimit.notice: Use while the game is running. Enable reading first, then load a character in the Over Limit screen.
overLimit.hint: Reads the four ability slots on the current Over Limit screen
overLimit.guide1: Start the game and enable reading. The character must have been over-limited at least once to be recognized.
overLimit.guide2: Perform one level-3 Over Limit and stop at the “Over the limit!” screen.
overLimit.guide3: Refresh, set the attributes, write them, then return to the game to confirm.
overLimit.guide4: Perform another level-3 Over Limit, then cancel without confirming replacement of the previous result.
overLimit.guide5: Save after completing the steps to persist the changes.
overLimit.empty: Enable reading, then load a character on the in-game Over Limit screen
overLimit.enableSuccess: Over Limit reading enabled; load a character on the Over Limit screen
overLimit.refreshMissing: Refreshed, but no character data was read. Switch characters once or reopen the Over Limit screen.
overLimit.writeSuccess: All four Over Limit slots were written; return to the game to confirm and save
